and affiliates."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Runs an online car marketplace and dealer software sold to auto dealers, not a publisher of editorial media brands."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Owns and sells physical outdoor displays such as billboards and transit ads, with no editorial publishing or affiliate commerce."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Sells ad verification and measurement software to advertisers, not media content or publications."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Owns lifestyle, health and personal finance media brands earning ads, sponsored content and affiliate commissions from readers, matching Arena's model."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Promotes concerts and sells tickets for live events, a live entertainment business with no publishing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Sells advertising on movie theater screens and distributes live events to cinemas, a place-based media business."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Publishes news and magazine brands monetized through ads and subscriptions, though its book and property listing units differ from Arena."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Is an agency holding company selling creative, media buying and PR services to brands, not a media brand owner."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Is a marketing and advertising agency group earning fees for campaigns, not a publisher of its own media properties."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Operates native ad technology placing sponsored links on third-party publisher sites, not owning and publishing its own brands."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Sells business management software and directory advertising to small local businesses, a different customer and product set."},{"label":"C13","good":false,"reason":"Owns radio stations and a cable TV network selling airtime, a broadcast business with FCC licensing rather than publishing."},{"label":"C14","good":true,"reason":"Owns consumer digital media brands earning ads, subscriptions and affiliate commissions from reviews, though it also sells software and cybersecurity."}]}
